title: Acids and Bases Around Us
summary: Sour lemons, soapy soap: find the acids and bases in your kitchen and bathroom, and learn to test them safely.

ib.note: Often the opening lesson of an MYP 2 acids unit

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: Exploring Substances: Acidic, Basic and Neutral

objectives: I can name common acids and bases found at home and describe their general properties.
I can explain why we never test substances by tasting or touching them.
I can use red and blue litmus to classify a substance as acidic, basic or neutral.
misconceptions: All acids are dangerous and burn you.
Bases are safe because they are the 'opposite' of acids.
Anything that dissolves in water is an acid.
